#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int num = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int ch;
    bool started = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            started = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            started = true;
            num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
        } else if (started) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -num : num;
}

int r, c;
long long C[64][64];
long long minDistance = LLONG_MAX;
vector<char> seqArr;
int countA[64], countB[64];
map<long long, long long> cacheMap;

void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long dist = llabs(x - y);
    if (minDistance <= 1 || dist - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= minDistance) return;
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        if (dist < minDistance) minDistance = dist;
        return;
    }
    if (v1 > 0) {
        long long deltaX = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        dfs(x, y + deltaX * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 > 0) {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], deltaY = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        dfs(x + s1 * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long key = x * 10000LL + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = cacheMap.find(key);
    if (it != cacheMap.end()) return it->second;
    long long res = 0;
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > minDistance) {
        cacheMap[key] = res;
        return res;
    }
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        cacheMap[key] = 1;
        return 1;
    }
    char c = seqArr[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        res += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        res += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cacheMap[key] = res;
    return res;
}

void execute() {
    r = readInt(); c = readInt(); getchar();
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    seqArr.assign(s.begin(), s.end());

    int size = 2 * (r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= size; j++) {
            if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
        if (x > y) {
            long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            y += c1 * s2;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            x += s1 * c2;
            v2--;
        }
    }
    minDistance = llabs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (seqArr[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (seqArr[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long answer = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    cout << answer << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    execute();
    return 0;
}
